english.meaning: a lot of; much, many (好多 = a lot; 多啲 = more)
english.note: On its own 多 often means "more" (多啲); "many people" is usually 好多人.

exampleSentences.english: Add more salt, and then this pot of soup will have enough flavor.
exampleSentences.traditional: 落多啲鹽，呢鍋湯先夠味。
